title: VANDIRA Candidate 360 Intelligence
purpose: Evidence-grounded candidate profiles connecting verified 2022 result identity, constituency context, booth/Form20 context and explicit current-intelligence gaps.

scope.candidate_entity_scope: normalized winner and runner-up entities across 403 constituencies

rules: Form20 candidate names are additive and are not promoted to verified party/vote facts without reconciliation.
A single election does not establish a candidate trend.
Current/latest candidate claims require fresh official or reputable-source retrieval.
Unknown or missing fields remain explicit gaps; they are never inferred.
2024 Lok Sabha data is not represented as a 2024 Assembly result.
political_safety: Use evidence-based public political intelligence; do not infer or target people using sensitive personal attributes.
